snippet.title: Kindling: New Boss
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3961820/Kindling/

CINDERMITE QUEEN BOSS REVEAL - She controls burning parasites and hunts from darkness.
Everything kills in one hit. Including her army.

Revealing Kindling's newest nightmare - the Cindermite Queen. This spider-witch spawns swarms of burning mites while using darkness to ambush you. Remember: one hit = death.

KINDLING: Top-down action roguelite where you're a witch trapped in your own nightmare. Use fire magic and campfires to survive the darkness. Every death makes you stronger with permanent ember upgrades.

#Kindling #IndieGame #Roguelite #BossFight #CindermiteQueen
